title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓~One World Trade Center
focus: 以高強混凝土核心筒、周邊延性鋼框架與岩盤基礎，建立兼顧風荷載與結構強健性的混合系統~A hybrid of high-strength concrete core, ductile perimeter steel frame and rock foundations balancing wind load and structural robustness
summary: 世界貿易中心一號大樓以約 61 m 見方的基座、逐漸削角收分的體量，把 14,000 psi 高強混凝土核心筒與周邊延性抗彎鋼框架組成混合抗側系統，再以展開基腳與岩錨坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上。本課從削角形體的風荷載、核心筒剛度與替代傳力路徑，走到岩盤基腳、尖塔分段吊裝、大體積高強混凝土的溫控與驗收，最後談強健性設計在營運期的改裝管制與尖塔維護。~One World Trade Center rises from a base about 61 m square with chamfered, tapering faces, combining a 14,000 psi high-strength concrete core and a ductile perimeter steel moment frame into a hybrid lateral system founded on Manhattan bedrock with spread footings and rock anchors. The course moves from wind on the chamfered form, core stiffness and alternate load paths to rock footings, staged spire erection, temperature control and acceptance of high-strength mass concrete, and finally to protecting robustness during later alterations and maintaining the spire.

units.anchor: 削角錐形體量~Chamfered tapering massing
units.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載~Chamfered tapering form and wind load
units.mechanism: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。迎風寬度隨高度遞減，使高處的風壓作用面積變小，而高處的力臂最長，所以基座傾覆力矩下降得比總風力更明顯；斜切的立面也讓背風側渦流脫落沿高度不同步，削弱橫風向的規律激振。形體因此不只是建築表情，而是降低抗側構件需求的第一道結構手段。~The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. Because the windward width shrinks with height, the pressure area is smallest where the lever arm is longest, so the base overturning moment falls faster than the total wind force; the inclined faces also desynchronise vortex shedding along the height, weakening regular across-wind excitation. The form is therefore the first structural measure that reduces demand on the lateral system, not just an architectural gesture.
units.model: 均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。取 q = 2.0 kPa、H = 417 m、B₀ = 61 m、B₁ = 43 m：稜柱 M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m，收分後 M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m，約減少 19.7%。數值為教學假設。~For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism. With q = 2.0 kPa, H = 417 m, B₀ = 61 m and B₁ = 43 m, the prism gives M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m and the tapered form M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m, about 19.7% less. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。~Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled.
units.failure: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。~Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise.
units.misconception: 削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。~Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads.
units.practice: 形體凍結前，結構團隊應以初步風洞或經驗係數比較兩到三種收分方案的基座力矩與加速度，把結果寫入設計基準報告，日後建築外形若再調整須重新取得結構確認。~Before the form is frozen, the structural team should compare base moment and acceleration for two or three taper options using a preliminary wind test or empirical coefficients, record the results in the design basis report, and require structural sign-off for any later change to the massing.

units.anchor: 核心筒—框架混合抗側系統~Core–frame hybrid lateral system
units.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工~Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame
units.mechanism: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。~Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy.
units.model: 僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。取外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m 的方形管 I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴、E = 48 GPa、w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m、H = 417 m：Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m，約 H/1,170；若外伸臂與框架使等效勁度提高 40%，Δ ≈ 0.254 m，約 H/1,640。數值為教學假設，忽略開口與內牆。~With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For a square tube 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴; with E = 48 GPa, w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m and H = 417 m, Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m, about H/1,170. If outriggers and frame raise the effective stiffness by 40%, Δ ≈ 0.254 m, about H/1,640. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings and interior walls.
units.verify: 在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。~In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions.
units.failure: 若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。~If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls.
units.misconception: 核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。~A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
units.practice: 設計基準應明列抗側系統的分工比例與每個子系統的容許變位角，並規定外伸臂的接合時機與調整機制，施工圖上要標示哪些接頭須待指定階段才能最終鎖定。~The design basis should state how lateral resistance is shared and the allowable drift for each subsystem, define when and how outriggers are connected, and mark on the drawings which joints may only be finally locked at a specified construction stage.

units.anchor: 14,000 psi 核心牆混凝土~14,000 psi core-wall concrete
units.title: 高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數~Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete
units.mechanism: 核心筒底部牆厚可達約 1.2 m，向上逐步減至約 0.6 m，所用混凝土強度由約 14,000 psi 漸降，公開資料指出這是紐約市首次採用此強度。對超高層核心筒而言，強度決定牆厚與可用樓地板面積，但控制側向變位與差異縮短的其實是彈性模數、潛變與收縮，因此配比同時規定模數須高於約 7×10⁶ psi，並針對潛變收縮設計；強度高於 8,000 psi 的部位採用自充填混凝土以確保密集鋼筋間的充填。~Core walls are up to about 1.2 m thick at the base and step down to about 0.6 m near the top, with concrete strengths stepping down from about 14,000 psi, reported as the first use of that strength in New York City. For a supertall core, strength sets wall thickness and usable floor area, but lateral drift and differential shortening are governed by modulus, creep and shrinkage, so the mixes also required a modulus above about 7×10⁶ psi and were designed for creep and shrinkage; self-consolidating concrete was used where strength exceeded 8,000 psi to fill around congested reinforcement.
units.model: ACI 318 經驗式 E_c = 57,000√f′c（psi）。f′c = 14,000 psi 時 E_c = 57,000×118.3 ≈ 6.74×10⁶ psi（約 46.5 GPa），規格要求 ≥ 7.0×10⁶ psi（約 48.3 GPa），高約 3.8%。以 12 MPa 均勻應力作用 100 m 高的牆段估算彈性縮短：經驗式模數得 25.8 mm，規格模數得 24.9 mm。數值為教學假設。~ACI 318 gives E_c = 57,000√f′c in psi. For f′c = 14,000 psi, E_c = 57,000×118.3 ≈ 6.74×10⁶ psi (about 46.5 GPa), while the specification required at least 7.0×10⁶ psi (about 48.3 GPa), roughly 3.8% stiffer. For a 100 m wall segment under a uniform 12 MPa stress, elastic shortening is 25.8 mm with the empirical modulus and 24.9 mm with the specified modulus. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 配比試拌階段同時做抗壓強度、靜彈性模數（ASTM C469）與潛變收縮試驗，確認模數與時間相依變形參數可直接輸入施工階段分析；量產期間依批次抽驗強度與模數，並追蹤骨材來源變更對模數的影響。~During trial mixes, test compressive strength, static modulus (ASTM C469) and creep and shrinkage so the modulus and time-dependent parameters can be fed directly into the construction-stage analysis; during production sample strength and modulus by lot, and track how changes of aggregate source affect the modulus.
units.failure: 只驗收強度而不驗收模數時，骨材來源改變可能讓模數下降一成以上而強度仍合格，結果核心筒變位、差異縮短與樓板傾斜都超出預測，帷幕牆與電梯導軌的調整空間被吃光。~Accepting strength without accepting modulus lets a change of aggregate source drop the modulus by ten percent or more while strength still passes, so core drift, differential shortening and floor tilt exceed predictions and consume the adjustment range of the façade and elevator rails.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。~Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion.
units.practice: 規範中把模數、潛變與收縮列為與強度同等的驗收項目，指定骨材來源變更須重新試拌並通知結構工程師；高強度自充填混凝土須另訂坍流度、析離與泵送試驗的允收值。~Make modulus, creep and shrinkage acceptance items equal to strength in the specification, require new trial mixes and notification of the structural engineer for any aggregate-source change, and set acceptance values for slump flow, segregation and pumping trials of high-strength self-consolidating concrete.

units.anchor: 周邊巨型鋼柱與延性接頭~Perimeter jumbo columns and ductile joints
units.title: 周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑~Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths
units.mechanism: 周邊框架使用約 45,000 美噸高強度鋼材，基座周邊柱採 ASTM A913 Grade 65 的 W14×730 熱軋型鋼，梁柱接頭使用預先認可的延性接頭。延性接頭讓框架在極端荷載下以梁端塑性變形耗能而不脆斷；公開資料也說明周邊梁可像「繩索」般作用，萬一某根周邊柱失效，荷載可經由梁的懸吊作用重新分配到相鄰柱與核心筒。高強度鋼讓同一斷面承載更多，也減少接頭與焊接數量。~The perimeter frame uses about 45,000 short tons of high-strength steel; base perimeter columns are ASTM A913 Grade 65 W14×730 rolled sections, and beam–column joints use prequalified ductile connections. Ductile joints let the frame dissipate energy through plastic rotation at beam ends instead of fracturing under extreme loads; public descriptions also say the perimeter beams can act like a rope, so if a perimeter column were lost, load could redistribute through hanging action to neighbouring columns and the core. Higher-strength steel carries more load per section and reduces the number of joints and welds.
units.model: W14×730 斷面積 A = 215 in²。Grade 65（F_y = 65 ksi）的軸向降伏 P_y = 215×65 = 13,975 kips ≈ 62,200 kN；同斷面若為 Grade 50 只有 10,750 kips ≈ 47,800 kN，高強度鋼使承載提高約 30%，或在相同軸力下可選用較輕斷面。~A W14×730 has A = 215 in². With Grade 65 steel (F_y = 65 ksi) the axial yield load is P_y = 215×65 = 13,975 kips ≈ 62,200 kN; the same section in Grade 50 gives only 10,750 kips ≈ 47,800 kN, so the higher-strength steel adds about 30% capacity, or allows a lighter section for the same axial load.
units.verify: 核對鋼廠檢驗證明的降伏強度、韌性（Charpy 衝擊值）與化學成分；巨型柱拼接與梁柱接頭依 AWS D1.1 做全滲透焊的超音波檢測，並以替代路徑分析確認移除任一周邊柱時，相鄰構件與接頭的需求容量比在允許範圍內。~Check mill certificates for yield strength, toughness (Charpy values) and chemistry; ultrasonically test complete-joint-penetration welds at jumbo-column splices and beam–column joints to AWS D1.1, and use alternate-path analysis to confirm that removing any single perimeter column keeps demand-to-capacity ratios of neighbouring members and joints within limits.
units.failure: 巨型斷面厚翼板若銲接程序不當，可能出現層狀撕裂或熱影響區脆化；接頭雖通過強度檢核，卻在極端事件時於焊道根部脆性破壞，使原本規劃的懸吊與重分配路徑無法形成。~Thick flanges of jumbo sections welded with an unsuitable procedure can suffer lamellar tearing or embrittled heat-affected zones; joints that pass strength checks may then fracture brittlely at the weld root in an extreme event, so the planned hanging and redistribution path never forms.
units.misconception: 只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。~If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
units.practice: 巨型型鋼焊接前須有經認可的焊接程序規範（WPS）、預熱與層間溫度管制，並對厚板做背面清根與超音波檢測；替代路徑所依賴的梁與接頭要在圖上標示為關鍵構件，日後不得任意開孔或更換。~Welding of jumbo sections needs qualified welding procedure specifications with controlled preheat and interpass temperature, back-gouging and ultrasonic testing of thick plates; beams and joints relied on for alternate paths should be marked as key elements on the drawings and must not later be cut or replaced at will.

units.anchor: 曼哈頓岩盤展開基腳~Spread footings on Manhattan bedrock
units.title: 岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工~Rock footings, rock anchors and work beside subways
units.mechanism: 結構向地下延伸約 21 m（70 ft），以展開基腳與條形基腳直接坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上，設計承壓至少約 60 美噸／平方英尺，局部加深開挖到更好的岩層可達約 114 美噸／平方英尺；另以伸入岩盤約 24 m（80 ft）的岩錨抵抗極端風下的上拔。部分基腳必須在仍在營運的地鐵線旁施作，因此開挖、爆破或破碎與支撐順序都要配合鐵路設施的振動與變位限制。~The structure extends about 21 m (70 ft) below grade and bears on Manhattan bedrock through spread and strip footings designed for at least about 60 short tons per square foot, with deeper excavation to better rock reaching about 114 tons per square foot; rock anchors extending about 24 m (80 ft) into the rock resist uplift under extreme wind. Some footings had to be built beside operating subway lines, so excavation, rock breaking and support sequences had to respect vibration and movement limits of the rail structures.
units.model: 60 tsf = 60×2,000/144 ≈ 833 psi ≈ 5.75 MPa；114 tsf ≈ 1,583 psi ≈ 10.9 MPa。若單一基腳承受 60 MN，所需面積 A = 60,000/5,746 ≈ 10.4 m²（約 3.2 m 見方）；在 10.9 MPa 岩層只需約 5.5 m²（約 2.3 m 見方）。數值為教學假設。~60 tsf = 60×2,000/144 ≈ 833 psi ≈ 5.75 MPa, and 114 tsf ≈ 1,583 psi ≈ 10.9 MPa. A footing carrying 60 MN needs A = 60,000/5,746 ≈ 10.4 m² (about 3.2 m square) at 5.75 MPa, but only about 5.5 m² (about 2.3 m square) on 10.9 MPa rock. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個基腳開挖到底後由大地工程師目視與鑽探確認岩質、節理與風化程度，必要時做岩盤承壓或孔內試驗，簽認後才可澆置；岩錨逐支做驗證拉拔試驗並鎖定預力，地鐵結構旁設置振動計與變位監測點，讀值超過預警值即停工檢討。~After each footing is excavated, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality, jointing and weathering by inspection and probe holes, with bearing or borehole tests where needed, and signs off before concrete is placed; every rock anchor gets a proof test and lock-off load, and vibration monitors and movement points on the adjacent subway structures stop work for review when alert levels are exceeded.
units.failure: 若岩盤中有未發現的風化帶或斷層泥，基腳可能產生不均勻沉陷，使核心筒與周邊柱出現額外差異變位；在地鐵旁爆破或破碎控制不當，則可能造成隧道襯砌裂縫或軌道變位而被迫停運。~An undetected weathered seam or fault gouge can cause uneven settlement of footings and add differential movement between core and perimeter columns; poorly controlled blasting or breaking next to the subway can crack tunnel linings or shift tracks and force service shutdowns.
units.misconception: 坐落在岩盤上的基礎不會沉陷，也不需要上拔設計。~Foundations on bedrock never settle and never need uplift design.
units.practice: 把基底驗收列為停留點：大地工程師、結構工程師與鐵路管理單位三方共同確認後才能澆置；在地鐵保護範圍內的作業須事先取得營運單位核准的施工方法與監測計畫。~Make founding-level acceptance a hold point requiring joint confirmation by the geotechnical engineer, structural engineer and rail operator before concrete is placed, and obtain the operator's approval of method statements and monitoring plans for any work inside the subway protection zone.

units.anchor: 尖塔分段吊裝~Staged spire erection
units.title: 124 m 尖塔的分段吊裝與高空接合~Staged erection and high-level splicing of the 124 m spire
units.mechanism: 主屋頂約 417 m（1,368 ft），其上約 124 m（408 ft）的尖塔把總高度帶到 1,776 ft（541.3 m）。尖塔由 18 段鋼構組成，坐落在由核心筒支承的鋼筋混凝土基座上，並帶有通訊平台環；最後兩段各約 23 m（75 ft），由屋頂上的塔吊從臨時工作平台吊起，與下段以 60 支螺栓在約 518 m（1,701 ft）高空接合。高處風速大且吊物迎風面積大，吊裝時的擺動與定位精度成為控制因素。~The main roof is about 417 m (1,368 ft), and a spire of about 124 m (408 ft) above it brings the total height to 1,776 ft (541.3 m). The spire was assembled from 18 steel sections on a reinforced-concrete base supported by the core and carries communication platform rings; the final two sections, each about 23 m (75 ft), were lifted from a temporary roof platform by a crane and joined to the lower sections with 60 bolts at about 518 m (1,701 ft). At that height strong wind on a large exposed piece makes swing and positioning accuracy the controlling factors.
units.model: 吊物側向風力 F = ½ρV²C_dA。取段長 22.9 m、投影寬 1.5 m（A = 34.4 m²）、C_d = 1.2：V = 15 m/s 時 F = 0.5×1.225×15²×1.2×34.4 ≈ 5.7 kN；V = 25 m/s 時 F ≈ 15.8 kN。若吊重約 18 t（W ≈ 177 kN），擺角 θ = atan(15.8/177) ≈ 5.1°，在 22.9 m 長的吊物上已難以對孔。數值為教學假設。~The side wind force on a lifted piece is F = ½ρV²C_dA. For a 22.9 m section with a 1.5 m projected width (A = 34.4 m²) and C_d = 1.2, V = 15 m/s gives F = 0.5×1.225×15²×1.2×34.4 ≈ 5.7 kN and V = 25 m/s gives F ≈ 15.8 kN. With a lifted weight of about 18 t (W ≈ 177 kN), the swing angle θ = atan(15.8/177) ≈ 5.1°, which already makes bolt-hole alignment on a 22.9 m piece impractical. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊裝前比對塔吊在該半徑與高度的荷重表、吊具與吊點的第三方檢驗紀錄，並以屋頂風速計的即時讀值確認在允許吊裝風速內；接合後量測尖塔垂直度與螺栓預拉力（扭矩或轉角法抽驗），並在每段完成後做測量定位紀錄。~Before each lift, check the crane load chart at the actual radius and height, third-party inspection records of rigging and lifting lugs, and live roof anemometer readings against the permitted lifting wind speed; after splicing, survey the spire's verticality, verify bolt pretension by torque or turn-of-nut sampling, and record the as-built position of every section.
units.failure: 若在陣風中強行對孔，吊物擺動可能撞擊已安裝段或平台、損傷接合面並危及高空作業人員；螺栓預拉力不足則讓接合面在風振下滑移，日後出現螺栓鬆動與疲勞裂縫。~Forcing alignment in gusts lets the swinging piece strike installed sections or platforms, damage the faying surfaces and endanger workers at height; insufficient bolt pretension lets the splice slip under wind vibration, later causing loosened bolts and fatigue cracks.
units.misconception: 尖塔不是主結構，吊裝時只要吊車容量足夠就沒有其他限制。~A spire is not primary structure, so crane capacity is the only lifting constraint.
units.practice: 吊裝計畫須明定停止吊裝的風速、尾繩控制、通訊與人員撤離區，並由起重作業主管與結構工程師共同簽認；每段接合完成並經檢驗前，不得移除臨時固定或進行下一吊。~The lifting plan must define the stop-work wind speed, tag-line control, communications and exclusion zones, signed by the appointed lifting supervisor and the structural engineer; temporary restraints must stay and the next lift must not start until each splice is completed and inspected.

units.anchor: 大體積混凝土溫控與強度驗收~Mass-concrete temperature and strength acceptance
units.title: 高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收~Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete
units.mechanism: 厚核心牆與基礎屬大體積混凝土，水泥水化熱使內部溫度升高，與表面的溫差會造成溫度裂縫。公開資料指出配比限制了波特蘭水泥用量，以冰取代部分拌合水並在較涼爽時段澆置，並在混凝土中埋設 RFID 溫度與成熟度記錄器追蹤內部溫度與強度發展。強度驗收則依統計：配比的目標平均強度必須高於規定強度，留出生產變異的餘裕，再以連續試體平均值與單一試體下限判定合格。~Thick core walls and foundations behave as mass concrete: heat of hydration raises the interior temperature and the difference from the surface can cause thermal cracking. Public descriptions say the mixes limited Portland cement, replaced part of the mixing water with ice, were placed during cooler hours, and contained embedded RFID loggers tracking internal temperature and maturity. Strength acceptance is statistical: the mix's target average strength must exceed the specified strength to allow for production variability, and lots are accepted by the average of consecutive tests and a lower limit for any single test.
units.model: ACI 318 對 f′c > 5,000 psi 的目標平均強度 f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s)。f′c = 14,000 psi、標準差 s = 1,000 psi：f′c + 1.34s = 15,340 psi，0.90f′c + 2.33s = 14,930 psi，故 f′cr = 15,340 psi（約 105.8 MPa）；單一試體不得低於 0.90f′c = 12,600 psi（約 86.9 MPa）。數值為教學假設。~For f′c > 5,000 psi, ACI 318 sets the required average strength f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s). With f′c = 14,000 psi and a standard deviation s = 1,000 psi, f′c + 1.34s = 15,340 psi and 0.90f′c + 2.33s = 14,930 psi, so f′cr = 15,340 psi (about 105.8 MPa); no single test may fall below 0.90f′c = 12,600 psi (about 86.9 MPa). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以埋設記錄器的溫度歷程計算成熟度並與現地養護試體比對，確認拆模與加載時機；核心與表面溫差超過規定值（例如 20 °C）即啟動保溫或延後拆模。強度以標準養護試體判定：每三組連續試驗平均不低於 f′c，且無單一試驗低於 0.90f′c。~Compute maturity from the embedded temperature histories and compare with field-cured specimens to decide stripping and loading times; when the core-to-surface temperature difference exceeds the specified limit, for example 20 °C, apply insulation or delay stripping. Accept strength on standard-cured specimens: every average of three consecutive tests at least f′c and no single test below 0.90f′c.
units.failure: 冰的配量或澆置時段控制不當，會讓大體積牆內部溫度過高，延遲鈣礬石形成或溫差裂縫在數月後才出現；若試體不合格卻缺乏成熟度與鑽心資料，只能以昂貴的鑽心與載重評估補救。~Poor control of ice dosage or placement timing lets interior temperatures in massive walls run too high, so delayed ettringite formation or thermal cracks may appear months later; if cylinders fail without maturity and core data, only costly coring and load evaluation remain as remedies.
units.misconception: 高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。~If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable.
units.practice: 大體積澆置前須有溫控計畫，列明最高內部溫度、最大溫差、感測器位置與超限應變措施；試體不合格時依預先約定的程序處理：先查成熟度與溫度紀錄，再決定鑽心或載重評估，由結構工程師簽認。~Before any mass pour, require a thermal control plan stating maximum interior temperature, maximum temperature difference, sensor locations and responses to exceedance; handle failed cylinders by a pre-agreed procedure that reviews maturity and temperature records before deciding on coring or load evaluation, signed off by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 風洞試驗與高度風壓剖面~Wind-tunnel test and pressure profile
units.title: 風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載~Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load
units.mechanism: 地表粗糙度使風速隨高度增加，曼哈頓密集高樓群形成粗糙的都市邊界層，超過 400 m 的屋頂所受風壓遠大於街道層。風洞試驗以縮尺模型重現邊界層剖面與周邊建物，量測各風向的整體力與帷幕牆局部風壓；整體力用於主結構，局部尖峰風壓用於帷幕牆與尖塔構件。由於高處風速高，風洞結果也決定頂部加速度、尖塔通訊環與屋頂設備的設計條件。~Ground roughness makes wind speed increase with height, and Manhattan's dense towers create a rough urban boundary layer, so pressures at a roof above 400 m are far higher than at street level. Wind-tunnel tests reproduce the boundary-layer profile and neighbouring buildings on a scale model, measuring overall forces for every direction and local cladding pressures; overall forces feed the primary structure and local peak pressures the curtain wall and spire members. Because winds aloft are strong, the tests also set the design conditions for top-floor acceleration, the spire's rings and roof equipment.
units.model: 冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，風壓 q ∝ V²。取 α = 0.25、V₁₀ = 22 m/s：q₁₀ = 0.5×1.225×22² ≈ 0.296 kPa；在 417 m，q = q₁₀×(41.7)^0.5 = 0.296×6.46 ≈ 1.91 kPa，對應風速約 55.9 m/s。這也說明第 1 單元取均布 2.0 kPa 只是粗估。數值為教學假設。~With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and q ∝ V², take α = 0.25 and V₁₀ = 22 m/s: q₁₀ = 0.5×1.225×22² ≈ 0.296 kPa, and at 417 m q = q₁₀×(41.7)^0.5 = 0.296×6.46 ≈ 1.91 kPa, a wind speed of about 55.9 m/s. This shows that the uniform 2.0 kPa in unit 1 is only a rough estimate. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 確認風洞報告的邊界層剖面、紊流強度與周邊模型範圍符合場址條件，並以不同風向的基座力矩與加速度預測對照設計值；局部風壓係數須以帷幕牆分區圖逐區轉換為設計風壓，並由結構與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。~Confirm that the wind-tunnel report's boundary-layer profile, turbulence intensity and proximity-model extent match the site, and compare predicted base moments and accelerations by direction with the design values; convert local pressure coefficients zone by zone into design pressures on the cladding zoning drawings, agreed by both structural and façade consultants.
units.failure: 若風洞未模擬周邊未來將興建的高樓，完工後鄰棟落成可能改變尾流與局部風壓，造成帷幕牆局部風壓超出設計；若高空風速被低估，尖塔與屋頂設備的固定件可能在暴風中疲勞或鬆脫。~If the wind tunnel ignores towers planned nearby, their later completion can change wakes and local pressures beyond the façade design values; underestimating winds aloft can let spire and roof-equipment fixings fatigue or loosen in storms.
units.misconception: 建築越高，風壓只隨高度成正比增加。~Wind pressure simply increases in direct proportion to height.
units.practice: 風洞報告應列出試驗所假設的周邊建物清單與未來情境，並訂定周邊重大開發完成後是否需要重新評估的條件；所有屋頂與尖塔附掛設備須以風洞局部風壓設計固定件。~The wind-tunnel report should list the surrounding buildings and future scenarios assumed and define when major nearby development triggers re-evaluation; all roof and spire attachments must have their fixings designed for the tunnel's local pressures.

units.anchor: 替代傳力路徑與改裝管制~Alternate load paths and alteration control
units.title: 強健性設計在營運期的維持~Keeping robustness intact during operation
units.mechanism: 強健性（防止連鎖倒塌）依賴的不只是構件強度，而是連續性與替代路徑：周邊梁與接頭能在某柱失效時以撓曲與懸吊作用把荷載轉送出去，核心筒則提供受保護的逃生梯與消防員專用梯。底部以厚實混凝土牆包覆大廳，公開資料說明其屬額外防護而非主結構。這些設計在營運期最容易被不知情的改裝破壞，例如切斷周邊梁、在核心牆開新孔或拆除防火被覆，因此強健性必須被記錄並納入改裝審查。~Robustness against progressive collapse depends not only on member strength but on continuity and alternate paths: perimeter beams and joints must transfer load by bending and hanging action if a column is lost, and the core provides protected exit stairs, including one reserved for first responders. Thick concrete walls enclose the lobby at the base, described publicly as added protection rather than primary structure. During operation these features are most easily defeated by uninformed alterations such as cutting perimeter beams, opening new holes in core walls or stripping fire protection, so robustness must be documented and built into alteration review.
units.model: 線性靜力替代路徑檢核：w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m。原跨度 9 m 時 M = wL²/8 ≈ 220 kN·m；移除一根柱後跨度變 18 m，M = 21.75×18²/8 ≈ 881 kN·m，再乘常用的動力放大係數 2.0 得 1,762 kN·m，約為原需求的 8 倍。數值為教學假設。~Linear-static alternate-path check: w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m. With the original 9 m span M = wL²/8 ≈ 220 kN·m; removing a column doubles the span to 18 m, M = 21.75×18²/8 ≈ 881 kN·m, and the commonly used dynamic factor of 2.0 gives 1,762 kN·m, about eight times the original demand. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接時建立關鍵構件清冊（周邊梁、接頭、核心牆開口、防火被覆範圍）並以圖面與照片記錄；每項改裝申請須經結構工程師以替代路徑模型核算，完工後現場確認被覆修補與構件未被切割。~At handover create a key-element register covering perimeter beams, joints, core-wall openings and fire-protection extents, documented with drawings and photographs; every alteration request is checked by the structural engineer against the alternate-path model, and after the work the site is inspected to confirm repaired fire protection and uncut members.
units.failure: 租戶裝修為了管線切斷周邊梁的翼板或腹板，平常看不出問題，但在某柱遭受火災或撞擊時，替代路徑提早失效，局部破壞可能擴大成多層塌落。~A tenant fit-out that cuts the flange or web of a perimeter beam for services shows no everyday distress, but if a column is hit by fire or impact the alternate path fails early and local damage can spread into multi-storey collapse.
units.misconception: 強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。~Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion.
units.practice: 物業管理規章中明訂：關鍵構件不得切割、焊接或開孔，防火被覆受損須於限期內修復，任何結構改裝須取得結構技師簽證；定期稽核時以關鍵構件清冊逐項巡查。~Building rules should state that key elements may not be cut, welded or penetrated, damaged fire protection must be repaired within a set time, and any structural alteration requires sign-off by a licensed structural engineer; periodic audits should walk through the key-element register item by item.

units.anchor: 尖塔與通訊環維護~Spire and antenna-ring maintenance
units.title: 尖塔熱變形、接合檢查與長期交接~Spire thermal movement, joint inspection and long-term handover
units.mechanism: 尖塔同時是結構、通訊設備支架與航空障礙燈的載體，長期承受風振、溫度循環與雷擊，螺栓接合與焊接附件是疲勞與腐蝕的熱點。日照使鋼構每日伸縮，通訊天線與纜線的固定方式必須容許這些位移；維護人員需定期攀登檢查螺栓預拉力、塗裝與排水孔。交接文件應把每段尖塔的位置、接合細部、預拉力紀錄與維護通道一併移交，讓營運單位能長期追蹤。~The spire is at once a structure, a support for broadcast equipment and a carrier of aviation obstruction lights, exposed for decades to wind vibration, temperature cycles and lightning, so bolted splices and welded attachments are hot spots for fatigue and corrosion. Sunlight makes the steel expand and contract daily, and antenna and cable fixings must accommodate those movements; maintenance crews must climb regularly to check bolt pretension, coatings and drain holes. Handover should transfer each section's position, splice details, pretension records and access routes so the operator can track them over the long term.
units.model: 熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT。尖塔長 L ≈ 124 m、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、日照與夜間溫差 ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×124,000×40 ≈ 60 mm。若纜線支架每 3 m 固定且不可滑動，每段需吸收約 60×3/124 ≈ 1.5 mm 的相對位移。數值為教學假設。~Thermal movement is ΔL = αLΔT. For a spire L ≈ 124 m long with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and a day–night temperature swing ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×124,000×40 ≈ 60 mm. If cable brackets every 3 m cannot slide, each segment must absorb about 60×3/124 ≈ 1.5 mm of relative movement. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期以扭矩扳手或超音波螺栓伸長量測抽驗接合預拉力，以目視與磁粒檢測檢查焊接附件根部，並在尖塔頂部設置加速度計記錄風振；雷擊或強風後執行事件檢查並與基準紀錄比對。~Periodically sample splice pretension with torque wrenches or ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement, inspect weld toes of attachments visually and by magnetic-particle testing, and record wind vibration with an accelerometer near the tip; after lightning strikes or storms carry out event inspections and compare with the baseline records.
units.failure: 附加天線或燈具時以現場焊接固定在主構件上，容易在焊趾產生疲勞裂縫；纜線固定過緊則在溫度循環下拉裂支架，長期造成水氣侵入與腐蝕。~Field-welding new antennas or lights directly to main members easily initiates fatigue cracks at weld toes; over-tight cable fixings crack brackets under temperature cycles and let moisture in, causing long-term corrosion.
units.misconception: 鋼構尖塔只有在颱風或暴風後才需要檢查。~A steel spire only needs inspection after a hurricane or storm.
units.practice: 交接時移交尖塔維護手冊：檢查週期、攀登與防墜系統、螺栓預拉力基準、附掛設備的審查流程與事件後檢查表；任何新增附掛物都須由結構工程師審查固定方式並禁止未經核准的現場焊接。~At handover provide a spire maintenance manual covering inspection intervals, climbing and fall-arrest systems, bolt-pretension baselines, a review procedure for new attachments and a post-event checklist; every new attachment must have its fixing method reviewed by the structural engineer, and unapproved field welding is prohibited.

example: 設計練習：以核心筒外圈牆檢核在重力與風力共同作用下是否出現拉應力。核心筒外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m，面積 A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m²，慣性矩 I ≈ 27,000 m⁴，斷面模數 S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³。核心筒承受重力 N = 1.2×10⁶ kN，平均壓應力 σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa。第 1 單元的收分基座力矩 8.52×10⁶ kN·m 中由核心筒分擔 60%，M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m，彎曲應力 σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa。最大壓應力 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa，只有 96.5 MPa（14,000 psi）的約 11%；最小應力 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa 仍為壓力。若某段牆的重力只有 0.4×10⁶ kN，σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa，最小應力變為 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa 的拉應力，就需要配置受拉鋼筋或岩錨來處理上拔。數值為教學假設，忽略開口、內牆與動力效應，不代表實際設計。~Design exercise: check whether the outer core walls go into tension under gravity plus wind. The core is 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, so A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m², I ≈ 27,000 m⁴ and the section modulus S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³. With a gravity load N = 1.2×10⁶ kN, the average compression is σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa. Taking 60% of the tapered base moment of 8.52×10⁶ kN·m from unit 1, M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m and the bending stress σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa. The maximum compression 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa is only about 11% of 96.5 MPa (14,000 psi), and the minimum 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa is still compressive. If a wall segment carried only 0.4×10⁶ kN of gravity, σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa and the minimum stress becomes 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa tension, calling for tension reinforcement or rock anchors to resist uplift. Values are teaching assumptions that ignore openings, interior walls and dynamic effects and do not represent the actual design.
history: 2001 年 9 月 11 日原世界貿易中心雙塔倒塌後，下曼哈頓重建由總體規劃開始，現行塔樓方案於 2005 年提出、2006 年動工，由 SOM 擔任建築與設計、WSP 擔任結構設計，並由 Leslie E. Robertson Associates 做同儕審查。設計把生命安全與強健性放在核心：高強混凝土核心筒包覆逃生梯與消防員專用梯，周邊延性鋼框架提供替代傳力路徑，14,000 psi 混凝土也首次在紐約市使用。2013 年 5 月尖塔最後兩段就位，2014 年 11 月大樓啟用。本課只重建公開資料中的結構原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件或安全防護細節。~After the original World Trade Center towers collapsed on 11 September 2001, the rebuilding of Lower Manhattan began with a master plan; the current tower scheme was put forward in 2005 and construction started in 2006, with SOM as architect and designer, WSP as structural engineer and Leslie E. Robertson Associates as peer reviewer. Life safety and robustness were central: the high-strength concrete core encloses the exit stairs and a stair for first responders, the ductile perimeter steel frame provides alternate load paths, and 14,000 psi concrete was used in New York City for the first time. The final spire sections were set in May 2013 and the building opened in November 2014. This course reconstructs structural principles and engineering logic from public sources only, not design documents or security details.
